caseNameFull: Hoover Company v. Coe, Commissioner of Patents
attorneys: Messrs. William D. Sellers, Richard R. Fitzsimmons, and William S. Hodges for petitioner., Solicitor General Fahy, Assistant Attorney General Shea, and Mr. Joseph B. Goldman for respondent. Messrs. J. Bernhard Thiess and Sidney Neuman filed a brief on behalf of Paul A. Sturtevant, as amicus curiae, in support of the petition.

opinions.text: Petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the District of Columbia granted.
